headline: Indian stock market faces pressure after benchmark indices post longest weekly losing streak in 25 years

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: En-masse selling by foreign institutional investors (FIIs) impacted market sentiment.
Indian equity markets fell for eight consecutive weeks, marking the longest weekly losing streak in 25 years.
Massive market capitalization losses occurred with Rs 9 lakh crore wiped out during recent sharp drops.
Uncertainty remains elevated ahead of market action on Monday amid global market cues.
whatHappening: Analysts expect Sensex and Nifty to remain volatile during the week of October 5 to 9, 2026.
Investors are closely tracking international market cues including Dow Jones, Nasdaq, Kospi, and Nikkei.
Airlines have requested Adani for records of consultations regarding Mumbai Airport T1 since 2020.
Government recruitments including SBI job notifications are listed among key non-market updates.
summary: Indian benchmark indices face significant headwinds today after completing an eight-week losing streak, the longest in 25 years. Relentless foreign investor selling wiped out trillions of rupees in investor wealth in recent sessions. Analysts anticipate continued volatility as markets digest foreign capital outflows and global macro cues.
